Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded D) coldest temperature by asserting the troposphere is the coldest layer, but the coldest region of the atmosphere is near the mesopause. The troposphere is best characterized by having the greatest density, containing most of the atmosphere’s mass, so the correct choice is B) greatest density.
